content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Online gumroad

Gumroad, for example, offers a simplistic, user-friendly interface for selling digital products, but it comes with a 3.5% + $0.30 per sale commission and limited payment options. Stripe, on the other hand, provides robust payment processing, but its availability is limited to only 46 countries, leaving many creators out in the cold. Meanwhile, PayPal's account suspension policies can hold your funds for up to 180 days with no appeal, rendering your store inaccessible. Each of these options has significant limitations that restrict your ability to sell and operate your digital store without compromise.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe's limited availability means that creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan are forced to look for alternative payment processors, which often come with higher fees or less reliable services. Gumroad's payment options are also limited, leaving creators in restricted countries with few choices. PayPal's account suspension policies, meanwhile, can affect creators worldwide, not just in restricted countries. In contrast, COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to operate independently of these platforms, allowing creators to sell and deliver digital products without relying on a single platform or subscription.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Gumroad's 3.5% + $0.30 per sale commission may seem reasonable, but it adds up quickly, especially for high-volume sales. Stripe's payment processing fees range from 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction for credit and debit cards to 0.8% + $0.05 per transaction for ACH transfers. Meanwhile, PayPal's fees range from 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction for domestic transactions to 4.4% + fixed fee for international transactions. COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack, on the other hand, offers a flat 0.5% fee for payment processing, with no additional commissions or fees. With COREMERCH, you keep 100% of your sales revenue, minus the payment processing fee.
COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full data ownership and control, allowing you to automate and deliver your digital products seamlessly.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When you use Gumroad or Stripe, you're essentially leasing your digital store from the platform, with all the associated risks and limitations. PayPal's account suspension policies can even render your store inaccessible. COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, gives you full data ownership and control, allowing you to automate and deliver your digital products seamlessly, without relying on a single platform or subscription. With COREMERCH, you can focus on creating and selling your digital products, without the burden of platform limitations.

If you're a digital creator in a restricted country, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack is the only option that offers robust payment processing, automation, and delivery, without relying on a single platform or subscription. If you're already established on Gumroad or Stripe, you can still migrate to COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure, taking full advantage of our 0.5% payment processing fee and 100% data ownership. Whichever option you choose, COREMERCH is committed to giving you the infrastructure you need to succeed in the digital commerce space.
